name: cashwerk – Daily Invoice Summary via Email

parameters.content:
## Daily Invoice Summary
Every morning at 08:00 this workflow fetches the latest invoices from cashwerk, builds a small HTML report and emails it to your finance inbox.

## Setup
1. Add your cashwerk API credential to *Get Invoices*.
2. Set sender/recipient and your SMTP credential in *Send Email*.
3. Adjust the schedule or the invoice filters if needed.

_Needs the **cashwerk** community node (`n8n-nodes-cashwerk`) and a cashwerk API key (cashwerk → Settings → API Platform)._
